items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: Jolly Roll Morton played with us. We went there to play with Jolly Roll for two nights.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, you mean Morton had his own band or he was playing with you? Jolly Roll Morton's band. Oh, you played with Jolly Roll Morton's band.
Yeah. Well, I was playing with Jolly Roll Morton's band. Yeah. Well, I was playing with Jolly Roll Morton's band. Oh, you played with Jolly Roll Morton's band? Yeah. Oh, you?
